subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which remaining takeover/session-delivery fix path should be canonical for #93383 now that #93740 fixed retained-lock release on main?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans session fencing, fallback retry policy, subagent final delivery, and channel typing cleanup, with multiple overlapping open PRs and maintainer labels blocking new autonomous fix PRs.

options.title: Sequence Existing PRs
options.body: Use #89039 and #91797, or narrowed replacements, as the canonical work before closing #93383.

options.title: Split Remaining Slices
options.body: Keep #93383 open as an umbrella but require separate focused issues for message-loss, benign no-op rewrites, and typing cleanup.

options.title: Close After Explicit Rejection
options.body: Close the umbrella only if maintainers decide the remaining false-positive and delivery behavior is out of scope or already adequately covered elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Sequence Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Use #89039 and #91797, or narrowed replacements, as the canonical work before closing #93383.
